components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Leading task action such as Convert.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--primary); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--primary); color: var(--paper); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font: 600 0.875rem/1.25rem var(--font-mono); transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-strong); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary task action such as Clear.
components.css: .ds-button-quiet { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font: 600 0.875rem/1.25rem var(--font-mono); transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-button-quiet:hover { border-color: var(--primary); color: var(--primary); } .ds-button-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Textarea Field
components.description: Technical source or target data field.
components.css: .ds-textarea { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 10rem; resize: vertical; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--field); color: var(--ink); padding: 1rem; font: 400 0.875rem/1.5rem var(--font-mono); transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-textarea:focus { border-color: var(--primary); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 15%, transparent); }

components.name: Format Select
components.description: Explicit source or target format selection.
components.css: .ds-select { width: 100%; min-height: 2.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--field); color: var(--ink); padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font: 600 0.875rem/1.25rem var(--font-mono); transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-select:focus { border-color: var(--primary); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 15%, transparent); }

components.name: Active Navigation Link
components.description: Current tool within desktop or drawer navigation.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: flex; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--field); color: var(--ink); padding: 0 0.75rem; font: 600 0.875rem/1.25rem var(--font-sans); text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--ink); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-nav-icon { display: inline-flex; width: 2rem; height: 2rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0.375rem; background: var(--panel); color: var(--accent); font: 400 0.75rem/1rem var(--font-mono); }

components.name: Conversion Workspace
components.description: Shared source, action, and target task surface.
components.html:
Source → Target

Conversion controls stay inside one task surface.
components.css: .ds-workspace { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0.75rem; background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); padding: 1.25rem; font: 400 1rem/1.5rem var(--font-sans); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-workspace strong { font-family: var(--font-display); } .ds-workspace p { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; color: var(--muted); }

components.name: Inline Error
components.description: Conversion error placed beside the affected workspace.
components.html: Input is not valid Base64.
components.css: .ds-error { border: 1px solid var(--danger); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--field); color: var(--danger); padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font: 500 0.875rem/1.25rem var(--font-sans); }

narrative.overview:
Codec Bench behaves like a clean room for technical data: crisp, modern, fast, and free of distractions. Cool Slate surfaces separate tools from fields while Instrument Blue identifies action and Syntax Orange carries identity and caution.

Controls stay restrained and familiar. Clear hierarchy, conventional interactions, and consistent 2.75rem targets let developers begin work without learning an interface. Responsive behavior changes structure at 48rem; typography stays stable and task-focused.

The system rejects cluttered converter sites such as base64decode.org: dense secondary content, weak hierarchy, dated square buttons, and outdated dropdown styling.
keyCharacteristics: Cool Slate tonal layering in light and dark themes
Instrument Blue for action; Syntax Orange for identity and caution
Restrained, familiar controls with consistent 2.75rem targets
Crisp structural borders with purposeful lift

rules.name: The Action Color Rule
rules.body: Instrument Blue belongs to primary actions, current selection, focus, and state feedback. It is never ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Orange Signal Rule
rules.body: Syntax Orange stays rare: brand slash, page context, caution, and danger only.

rules.name: The Technical Voice Rule
rules.body: Monospace belongs to data and compact controls. Never use it for long explanations or whole-page atmosphere.

rules.name: The Lifted, Never Floaty Rule
rules.body: Use one structural border plus compact shadow vocabulary. Never add wide ambient glow or decorative glass blur.

dos: Do preserve source → action → target hierarchy on every converter.
Do use 2.75rem minimum targets, visible focus, keyboard operation, and WCAG 2.2 AA contrast.
Do reserve Instrument Blue for action and Syntax Orange for identity, caution, and danger.
Do keep technical data monospace and explanatory text sans-serif.
Do support light, dark, 320px-wide, 200% text, and reduced-motion contexts.
donts: Don't build cluttered converter sites such as base64decode.org with dense secondary content or weak hierarchy.
Don't use dated square buttons or outdated dropdown styling.
Don't add decorative gradients, glassmorphism, wide glow, or animated spectacle.
Don't place explanatory content inside the primary conversion path when it can follow the workspace.
Don't invent unfamiliar controls when native buttons, selects, textareas, details, and links cover the task.
